rules.name: baseline
rules.note: shipped rule: HOLD when voice risk >= 75 and 3 of the last 5 windows are flagged

rules.name: quality-aware persistence
rules.note: degraded audio: HOLD needs 4 of 5 flagged windows (else 3 of 5)

rules.name: confirmed HOLD
rules.note: voice HOLD condition must hold on two consecutive windows

rules.name: median-of-3 smoothing
rules.note: each window uses the median score of itself and the 2 before it

rules.name: degraded audio caps voice-only at VERIFY
rules.note: noisy audio: voice alone gives VERIFY (OTP / call-back), not HOLD

split.name: degraded audio caps voice-only at VERIFY
